transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um, hi. I'm just... I'm here because I've been having some trouble lately. With my work. 

I've been trying to get some applications and research notes done, and... I just keep making these stupid mistakes. Like, I'll put the wrong date on a piece of artwork, or I'll just completely skip a question on a form. And the thing is, I always think I've checked everything over. But then someone else looks at it, and... yeah. It's just getting kind of embarrassing, honestly. So I thought I should probably talk to someone.
Do you think you're paying attention when you're working on these applications and research notes?

Yeah... I mean, I think I am. That's the thing. 

Like I said, I honestly thought I had checked them. I'll look over the notes or the forms, and I feel like I'm paying attention, but... I just don't see the mistakes until it's too late. That's kind of what finally made me come in, honestly. Just... not understanding how I keep missing them.
Are you trying your best when working on these applications and research notes?

Yeah. I am trying. I mean... I really do try to get it right. 

But like I said, I still end up turning them in with those stupid little mistakes. The wrong dates, or a skipped question... I try my best to check everything, but they just slip through anyway. I don't really know what else to do differently.
Do you find your mind wandering while you're working on these applications and research notes?

Um... yeah. I guess so. 

Like... if I'm at my desk trying to read or write, it doesn't take much. A siren outside, or... someone talking out in the hall. Or even just a random thought about an exhibit idea I had. I'll just... drift off. And then twenty minutes go by before I even realize I stopped working. So... yeah, I guess it wanders.
Do you often find yourself fidgeting or feeling restless while sitting at your desk working on applications and research notes?
No, not really. I mean... I can sit still fine. I just... get distracted, like I said. But I'm not, you know, bouncing around or anything. I just sit there.
Do you feel anxious when you're working on these applications and research notes?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think so. I just... it's just hard to stay on track, like I said. But I wouldn't say I feel anxious.
Do you often feel tired when working on these applications and research notes?
Um... no. I don't think so. Not tired, just... what I said before. I just lose focus.
Do you have trouble remembering things that happened recently?
Um... no. I don't think so. My memory is fine, I think. I don't really forget things that just happened.
Do you have trouble organizing your work or tasks?

Um... yeah, I guess. It's just... my apartment and my laptop are kind of full of half-started projects. Just... rent papers, gallery notes, article PDFs... to-do lists everywhere. I just have a hard time figuring out what actually needs to happen first.
Do you often act on impulse without thinking things through?
Um... no, not really. I don't think I do that. I wouldn't really say I'm impulsive, I guess.
Have you been feeling sad or down most of the time lately?
Um... no. Not really. I mean, I feel fine, mostly. Just... normal, I guess.
Have you been feeling guilty about anything lately?
Um... no. Not that I can think of. I don't really have a reason to be, I guess.
Have you been feeling worthless lately?
No, I don't think so. I don't feel worthless.
Do you feel upset or frustrated when you notice these mistakes in your work?
Um... I don't know. Not really. I just... fix it, I guess. It's not really a big deal.
Do you feel embarrassed by these mistakes most of the time?

Yeah... I guess so. It's actually, um, what finally made me come in here. I just... I keep turning in applications or research notes with these small mistakes. Like, I'll mislabel an artwork date or just skip a question completely. And yeah, it's embarrassing, because I... I honestly thought I had checked them.
Do you feel mentally drained after working on these applications and research notes?

Yeah... I guess so. Um... I think that's why I tend to put them off. If I know something is going to take a lot of concentration... like drafting a curatorial proposal or reading some dense theory chapter... I just... I'll do smaller errands instead. Just put it off until it's suddenly the night before it's due.
Are you having trouble completing tasks or meeting deadlines outside of work?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I've turned things in late. And... missed a couple of deadlines for things I wanted to apply for. It's... a mentor of mine actually mentioned it. Said my lack of follow-through was... starting to hurt my chances at things I should be ready for. So... yeah.
Do you have difficulty sustaining attention in activities or play during times when you are not working on applications or research notes?

Um... I don't really know. I guess I haven't really noticed. I mean, if I'm not doing something for school or work, I'm usually just... hanging out or doing whatever. So I'm not really sure if I lose focus then.
Do you have trouble paying attention or making careless mistakes when you're doing things you enjoy?
Um... no. Not really. If it's something I actually enjoy doing, I don't think I have a problem focusing on it. And... I haven't really noticed making any careless mistakes then.
